facts.quote: The ad aligned brand storytelling with performance goals, achieving a 72% increase in website traffic and a 14% lift in sales.

facts.fact: The article states that brief ad exposures under two seconds can contribute to sales when accumulated across the media mix.

facts.fact: The article describes portfolio ROAS as a holistic approach that lets business leaders evaluate how different investments work together across the funnel.
